scope.selection: All files under audit/config within the 16 MiB per-file bound are read as bytes and decoded only as UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16; opaque files are listed. Includes original raw-base64 outputs and inert task-input literals, historical success/failure and active/closed configurations.
scope.consistency: Per-file local snapshots, not an atomic filesystem or cloud snapshot. New files produced concurrently are listed as unknown scan boundary.

physical_key_resolution.rule: ObjectStoreArtifactStore._key computes prefix + slash + validate_key(relative_key). Relative references remain scoped to their frozen producer prefix, never joined across prefixes by basename.
prefix_precedence: unverified engineering default when no producer binding was available
physical_key_resolution.sha256_basenames_are_not_uniform: Feature objects use content hashes; manifests/intents use request/plan identities; attempt reports and windows can use logical identities. No filename alone verifies content or reclaimability.

not_proven_reclaimable: Multiple local references to one physical key describe sharing, not multiple stored copies.
Different keys claiming the same SHA256 are only duplicate candidates until exact bytes and complete references are verified in QC Cloud. All referenced identities remain protected.
A failed or closed task can retain valid data and incomplete-write forensic evidence; its status is never a deletion rule.
A completed window may retain its original intent by design; matching window and intent do not make the intent garbage.
Same SID/date/value projection, schema version folder, digest-like filename or rounded UI size does not prove equivalent bytes or removable identity.
An object absent from this local root list is not an orphan: cloud manifests, window_refs, event streams, implicit schema-derived keys and other projects provide unseen edges.
unknown_reference_boundary: No QC Object Store was listed or read by this local scan; object existence, exact sizes and hashes remain unknown.
Cloud-only window manifests, receipt first/cache_only_replay window_refs, payload/provenance pointers and received reference manifests require transitive resolution inside QC Cloud.
Unqualified or assumed prefix references require producer ownership confirmation before any inventory comparison.
Opaque/nontext files, nonliteral generated inputs, parse bounds and concurrently added files remain unresolved; retain conservatively.
ObjectStoreArtifactStore locks are in-process RLocks. Do not invent physical removable lock objects from their string names.

Explicit synthetic markers are filtered, but unlabeled constructed review fixtures can still contribute references and placeholder-shaped expected digests. Retain them conservatively until exact producer ownership is established.

Current default prefix candidates for old frozen engineering packages are not an exact-runtime prefix certification. Original runtime/source or cloud-side producer metadata must establish the final owner.

local_fixture_boundary.source_origin_is_metadata_only: Historical review outputs include constructed known-answer samples. Their literal keys and digest claims are conservative candidate references, not actual cloud object observations.

prior_scan_observation.reason: Expanded to every file, including .stdin/.trace/no-suffix source archives; added explicit review-fixture ambiguity and real local frozen-package namespace metadata.
